name: Slider
description:
The Slider component allows users to make selections from a range of values by dragging one or more thumbs along a track. It is composed of several primitives that enable customization and flexibility in its usage.

Rendered on its own, Slider displays the control, track, range and one thumb per value, with optional marks and a dragging indicator. Children such as `Slider.Label` and `Slider.ValueText` render as a header above the control. It supports different sizes, usages, palettes and a vertical orientation to match the design requirements of your application.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An entry abstraction that renders a header from its children, the control, track, range, one thumb per value and optional marks

props.name: marks
props.description: The marks to render along the track. A number renders as its own label; an object renders `label` (or its `value` when no label is given).

props.name: showIndicator
props.description: Shows a dragging indicator with the thumb's value while a thumb is dragged or focused.

parts.name: Thumbs
parts.description: Renders one thumb per slider value, each with its hidden input and an optional dragging indicator

props.name: showIndicator
props.description: Shows a dragging indicator with the thumb's value while it is dragged or focused. A direct `Slider.DraggingIndicator` child also shows it.

props.name: children
props.description: Direct `Slider.Thumb`, `Slider.DraggingIndicator` and `Slider.HiddenInput` children patch those parts on every thumb (a thumb's `index` is ignored); other children render inside every thumb.

parts.name: Marks
parts.description: Renders a marker group with one marker, indicator and label per mark

props.name: marks
props.description: The marks to render along the track. A number renders as its own label; an object renders `label` (or its `value` when no label is given).

parts.name: MarkerIndicator
parts.description: The dot rendered inside a marker, styled by the slider recipe's `markerIndicator` slot

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The root container of the Slider component.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the slider. Useful for composition.

props.name: name
props.description: The name associated with each slider thumb (when used in a form)

props.name: form
props.description: The associate form of the underlying input element.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the slider

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of the slider when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the value of the slider.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the slider is disabled

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the slider is read-only

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the slider is invalid

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Function invoked when the value of the slider changes

props.name: onValueChangeEnd
props.description: Function invoked when the slider value change is done

props.name: onFocusChange
props.description: Function invoked when the slider's focused index changes

props.name: getAriaValueText
props.description: Function that returns a human readable value for the slider thumb

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum value of the slider

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum value of the slider

props.name: step
props.description: The step value of the slider

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The step value of the slider when the `Shift` key is held, or the `PageUp`/`PageDown` keys are used.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: The minimum permitted steps between multiple thumbs. `minStepsBetweenThumbs` * `step` should reflect the gap between the thumbs. - `step: 1` and `minStepsBetweenThumbs: 10` => gap is `10` - `step: 10` and `minStepsBetweenThumbs: 2` => gap is `20`

props.name: orientation
props.description: The orientation of the slider

props.name: origin
props.description: The origin of the slider range. The track is filled from the origin to the thumb for single values. - "start": Useful when the value represents an absolute value - "center": Useful when the value represents an offset (relative) - "end": Useful when the value represents an offset from the end

props.name: thumbAlignment
props.description: The alignment of the slider thumb relative to the track - `center`: the thumb will extend beyond the bounds of the slider track. - `contain`: the thumb will be contained within the bounds of the track.

props.name: thumbSize
props.description: The slider thumbs dimensions

props.name: thumbCollisionBehavior
props.description: Controls how thumbs behave when they collide during pointer interactions. - `none` (default): Thumbs cannot move past each other; excess movement is ignored. - `push`: Thumbs push each other without restoring their previous positions when dragged back. - `swap`: Thumbs swap places when dragged past each other.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges props and accessibility attributes onto the immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper DOM node.

props.name: unstyled
props.description: Strips Cerberus PandaCSS recipe classes while preserving behavior and WAI-ARIA attributes.

props.name: css
props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.
